title: Card Accounting Basis Memorandum: Settling the Correction Credited on a Late Payment Fee
content:
Reconciliation of a card account under Personal Credit Cards settles the correction credited on a late payment fee from two figures and a ceiling.

**The fee as billed.** The fee as billed is the amount of the most recent late payment fee entry posted to the card account, selected by posted date.

**The credited share.** The credited share is 35 percent.

**What the share acts on.** The credited share acts on the fee as billed alone. No relationship addition is made, the relationship addition standing at 0.00 USD.

**Rounding and ceiling.** The product of the fee as billed and the credited share is rounded half-up to the cent, and the correction credited is the lesser of that rounded figure and the fee as billed.

**The entry that carries it.** The part of a billed late payment fee that the charter does not allow the bank to keep is credited back as one reversal entry carrying that late payment fee as its source item, and that entry is never larger than the fee as billed.

**Worked on hypothetical figures.**

| Late payment fee entries on the card account | Fee as billed | Product of fee and share | Rounded to the cent | Lesser of that figure and the fee as billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| one entry of 41.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 14.35 | 14.35 USD | 14.35 USD |
| one entry of 29.00 USD | 29.00 USD | 10.15 | 10.15 USD | 10.15 USD |
| 25.00 USD posted in March, 32.00 USD posted in July | 32.00 USD | 11.20 | 11.20 USD | 11.20 USD |

The third row shows the selection at work: the entry posted in July is the most recent by posted date, so the March entry is not the fee as billed.
